headline: Dak Prescott throws 3 TD passes, Javonte Williams runs for 155 yards as Cowboys beat Eagles 38-21
summary: — Tanner McKee and the Philadelphia Eagles still had a potential victory within their grasp in the fourth quarter when the career backup threw a pass into the outstretched hands of DeMarvion Overshown.

headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley says hamstring 'great' in return, not sweating back issue
summary: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley said his "hamstring came out great" and doesn't believe his back issue will keep him out after a gutsy and highly efficient performance in a loss to the Cowboys on Monday night.

headline: Cardinals WR Jalen Brooks to miss rest of season with wrist injury
